title: Clarified write/verify docs and concrete error-to-fix chains
points: The query-engine docs now include a Write and Verify diagram showing how a bounded evidence package becomes an answer and how claims are checked against tables, warnings, trace stages, and source pages.

The error-to-fix section now uses concrete examples that show the user-visible error, the trace evidence that located the cause, the actual fix, and the regression or corpus guard that keeps it from recurring.
Each error-to-fix example links directly to the relevant changelog entry so readers can navigate from the repair pattern to the specific shipped change.
